── 2026-11-09 (task 18, first increment). lib/editor-crdt/node-ydoc.ts: NodeLayout <-> Yjs document (toYDoc, serializeLayout), encodeState/applyRemote for snapshots and peers, createClientUndo (tracks local origin only, so undo never reverts a collaborator) and editLocal. Proven by lib/editor-crdt/node-ydoc.test.ts over the frozen 37-document corpus: exact round trip, state encode/decode, two clients converge on different fields of one block, per-client undo. yjs is the only new dependency; y-prosemirror and the Tiptap collaboration extension arrive with E4 where they are first used. NOT YET: Realtime channel + server-side authz, awareness, debounced draft snapshot with sanitizeNodeLayout at the boundary, reconnect/offline replay, and the public-bundle ratchet (nothing public imports lib/editor-crdt). BLD-401 and BLD-403 build on this module.

── 2026-11-09 (task 18, second increment). lib/editor-crdt/snapshot.ts: snapshotForStorage reads the Yjs doc and runs sanitizeNodeLayout, so validation sits at the snapshot/publish boundary (null keeps the previous draft); lib/editor-crdt/awareness.ts: readPresence clamps ephemeral presence payloads (node ids only, never content, never persisted). Still NOT done: Realtime channel + server-side authz, reconnect/offline replay, the draft-row writer, the public-bundle ratchet.

── 2026-11-10 (task 18, third increment). lib/editor-crdt/channel.ts: the pure half of the Realtime transport. editorTopic/parseEditorTopic name the private Broadcast topic `editor:<kind>:<id>` (kind from the four EntityKinds, id a bounded uuid shape) so the browser provider and the server-side realtime.messages policy share one definition; encodeUpdate/decodeUpdate wrap a Yjs update in a versioned base64 envelope with a 256 KB cap and reject oversize, empty, malformed or wrong-version payloads without throwing. channel.test.ts carries a real doc through the envelope to a second doc. Still open: the realtime.messages authorization policy keyed on that topic (a migration, needs the edit-permission predicate and a db-tests run), the browser provider that joins the channel, reconnect replay, the draft-row writer and the public-bundle ratchet.

── 2026-11-10 (task 18, fourth increment, DRAFT, not applied). supabase/migrations/20270346033000_editor_realtime_authz.sql: private.editor_topic_entity/editor_may_join and two realtime.messages policies (select/insert, authenticated only) on editor:<kind>:<uuid>. Kinds space and site resolve to a spaces row and reuse private.can_write_space_content, the page-write rule, so a person who may not save the page cannot join the room that edits it; member and email kinds fail closed until they have a rule. supabase/tests/editor_realtime_authz.test.sql pins the parser, the reuse, the grants and the policy roles. NOT proved: a rejected or admitted join on a real socket. Needs the migration-readiness policy PR, then db-tests on the exact head, then merge, then Daniel applies the SQL and the ledger row.
